description: Matched observable attribution regression probes; no private data. New expanded suites reported separately.
loader: Exact resolved module ID override, frozen HEAD core in all paired runs; HEAD adapter in before only. Loader asserts core was loaded. No production replacement or index mutation.

sameFork.dimensions: Both colours by vertical colour reflection; full and root-only best lines; no scores; two independent original-victim fork proofs. Unequal bounds are diagnostic, never compared as exact values in the implementation.
sameFork.contract: Four certified same-target played forks must not have What you missed: Fork title; two genuine missed fork controls retain it.

namedMate.dimensions: Both colours by vertical colour reflection; each best and played move legally replays to actual immediate checkmate; same and different mating geometries.
namedMate.contract: Playing actual checkmate cannot miss another named mate-in-one; no missed motifs or tactical mistake explanation.

expandedOwnedSuites.additionalControls: Reversed unequal bounds, no scores, unsafe played fork, distinct victim identities despite equal bounds, engine-nominated matching and different forks, nonvacuous root timeline, neutral perspective and selection, unrelated proved allowed loss priority, genuine missed named mate, illegal played move and later-only named mate. Checking and compound exclusions preserve evidence without treating existing blame as adjudicated gold.

limitations: Synthetic regression and source evidence only; root owns current-core broad tests, staged-only verification, generated services, final build and delivery. Ordinary nonchecking same-role/same-landing forks only; unequal whole-position value is not adjudicated.
